title: TSRL: Trigger-based Supervised Reinforcement Learning for Continual Agent Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.17726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents excel at complex, multi-step tasks but suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual learning--acquiring new skills often degrades previously mastered capabilities. Existing post-training paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is sample-efficient but prone to severe forgetting, while Reinforcement Learning (RL) preserves prior capabilities but converges slowly without expert guidance. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trigger-based Supervised Reinforcement Learning (TSRL), a framework that integrates the strengths of both paradigms through an adaptive, state-dependent expert supervision mechanism. TSRL employs RL as the optimization backbone, activating SFT selectively on "hard states" where the policy fails. translated_title: TSRL：面向持续智能体训练的基于触发的监督强化学习
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂的多步任务中表现出色，但在持续学习过程中会遭遇灾难性遗忘——学习新技能往往会损害之前已掌握的能力。现有的后训练范式面临一个根本性的权衡：监督微调（SFT）样本效率高，但容易出现严重的遗忘；而强化学习（RL）能够保留先前的能力，但在缺乏专家指导的情况下收敛缓慢。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了基于触发的监督强化学习（TSRL），这是一个通过自适应的、依赖状态的专家监督机制来整合两种范式优势的框架。TSRL以强化学习作为优化的主干，并在策略失败的“困难状态”上选择性地激活SFT。在理论上，我们证明将专家监督限制在失败状态可以为累积参数更新推导出一个上界，从而减少遗忘……（原文摘要至此处被截断）
tldr: 提出TSRL框架，以强化学习为优化主干、仅在策略失败的“困难状态”上选择性触发SFT专家监督，从而在LLM智能体的持续训练中既能高效习得新技能，又能有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: TSRL employs RL as the optimization backbone and selectively triggers SFT expert supervision only on "hard states" where the policy fails, enabling LLM agents to acquire new skills during continual training while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
